title: SUSPENSION INTERNATIONAL PARTS: SUSPENSION INTERNATIONAL/CONTROL ARM (96 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET CONTROL ARMS FOR USE ON 1967-1973 FORD MUSTANG VEHICLES.   THE CONTROL ARMS USED ON FORD FAIRLANE VEHICLES WERE SHIPPED WITH ONES INTENDED FOR USE ON THE FORD MUSTANG.  THE CONTROL ARMS ARE DIFFERENT IN LENGTH.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: MONACO/FRAME TOWER (1,329 affected)

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/SECONDARY HOOD LATCH (219,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH SPRING CAN DISENGAGE FROM ITS RETENTION HOLE IF THE HOOD IS SLAMMED SHUT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/AUTO TRANSMISSION (100,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AX4S AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLES.   THE LOW/INTERMEDIATE SERVO COVER CAN SEPARATE FROM THE TRANSAXLE WHILE THE VEHICLE IS BEING DRIVEN.  IF THIS OCCURS, TRANSMISSION FLUID WILL LEAK CONTACTING THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: SUZUKI/MOTORCYCLES/WHEEL OSCILLATION (2,935 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  FRONT WHEEL MOVEMENT AND RAPID SIDE-TO-SIDE HANDLEBAR MOVEMENT CAN OCCUR WHEN THE FRONT WHEEL IS LIGHTLY LOADED AND HITS A BUMP.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/BATTERY CABLE ROUTING (107 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH CUMMINS 6B ENGINES AND DELCO ALTERNATORS.  THE BATTERY CABLE ROUTING ALLOWS THE CABLE TO CONTACT THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

title: redundant PREVOST CAR, INC. Inactive: PREVOST/SUB-FRAME SUPPORT (1,245 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT BUSES.  THE REAR SUSPENSION FORWARD RADIUS ROD SUPPORT NEEDS REINFORCEMENT AND THE RADIUS ROD RETAINING BOLTS COULD BECOME LOOSE.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/SAFETY BELT WEBBING (3,106 affected)

THE OUTBOARD SAFETY BELT WEBBING ON THE DRIVER'S AND/OR PASSENGER'S SEAT CAN SEPARATE DURING A FRONTAL IMPACT.

title: HPA MONON TRAILER, INC.: HPA MONON/PARKING BRAKES (39 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRAILER CONVERTER DOLLIES.  AN AIR LINE WAS CONNECTED TO AN INCORRECT PORT IN THE AIR VALVE CAUSING THE PARKING BRAKE TO BE INOPERATIVE.

title: redundant NEW FLYER OF AMERICA, INC.: NEW FLYER/DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHTS (218 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  TRANSIT BUSES.  THE DAYTIME RUNNING LAMP (DRL) MODULE CAN OVER-HEAT AND SHUT DOWN AFTER AS LITTLE AS 45 MINUTES OF HIGH BEAM USE.  THIS WILL CAUSE TOTAL HEADLAMP FAILURE OF BOTH HIGH AND LOW BEAM.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FUEL TANK SENDING UNIT (3,792 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   THESE VEHICLES HAVE A TORN FUEL TANK SENDING UNIT/PUMP SEAL.  THIS CAN CAUSE FUEL ODOR AND/OR LEAKAGE AT THE ATTACHMENT LOCATION.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EVENFLO/HARNESS ADJUSTER (150,195 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  CHILD RESTRAINT SEATS, MODEL NUMBERS BEGINNING WITH 219, 224, 225, AND 229 MANUFACTURED FROM  OCTOBER 14, 1996 THROUGH FEBRUARY 6, 1997.  THESE SEATS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS," WHICH LIMITS HEAD EXCURSION.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EVENFLO/HEAD INJURY CRITERIA (35,856 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  SIDEKICK CHILD BOOSTER SEATS, MODEL NOS. 244 MANUFACTURED FROM APRIL 23, 1996 THROUGH MAY 20, 1997.   THESE SEATS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS," WHICH LIMITS HEAD INJURY CRITERIA.  IN RECENT TESTS ON SOME OF THESE BOOSTER SEATS, THE HEAD INJURY CRITERIA SCORED MORE THAN ALLOWED BY THIS STANDARD.

title: Webb Wheel Products, Inc.: WEBB WHEEL/STEER AXLE HUBS (4,982 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  STEER AXLE HUBS FOR USE ON TRUCKS AND TRACTORS, PART NUMBERS WEBB 1530, VOLVO 90402-0006, OR EATON F1960.  THESE HUBS WERE SOLD TO AND INSTALLED ON NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED BY VOLVO GM HEAVY TRUCK CORPORATION.  THE STEERING AXLE HUB FLANGE CAN FRACTURE AND SEPARATE FROM THE BARREL PORTION OF THE HUB.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/SAFETY BELT WEBBING (4,369 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   THE SEAT BELTS IN THESE VEHICLES INCORPORATE AN ENERGY MANAGEMENT LOOP.  THIS LOOP IS INADEQUATE TO ABSORB THE NECESSARY FORCES THAT CAN BE EXERTED ON IT.  THEREFORE, THE VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/COMPACT SPARE TIRE (652 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   THE COMPACT SPARE TIRE ASSEMBLIES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH INCORRECT RIMS.  IF THE SPARE TIRE IS UNDERINFLATED, THE BEAD CAN SEPARATE FROM THE RIM CAUSING A RAPID LOSS OF AIR.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 110, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS."

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/PASSENGER AIR BAG (16,099 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.   THE FASTENERS THAT SECURE THE PASSENGER AIR BAG MODULE TO THE INSTRUMENT PANEL TIE BAR WERE OMITTED.
